target.title: fix(macos): harden fresh AI onboarding
target.body:
Closes #102614

AI-assisted change; implementation and proof were reviewed by the submitting maintainer.

## What Problem This Solves

Fresh macOS onboarding had three related failure modes:

- A valid native Codex CLI login was detected, but the real test fell back to OpenClaw's generic OpenAI API-key path before the Codex runtime was active.
- Setup failures were reduced to short summaries, leaving users without selectable, copyable technical details.
- The AI-powered Crestodian helper could be offered before the effective default agent had any inference model, including stale Settings state after configuration changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Let transport-owning harnesses declare that they own auth bootstrap. The Codex harness now imports the native CLI's persistent OAuth or API-key login into the isolated test/agent home instead of requiring `OPENAI_API_KEY` in OpenClaw.
- Stage the Codex plugin, enablement, and model-scoped runtime pin before the real completion, then persist that delta only after success. Explicit runtime policy wins over custom OpenAI endpoint defaults, while plugin allow/deny policy failures surface as failures rather than false success.
- Preserve a friendly setup summary while exposing sanitized monospaced details with expand/collapse, selection, and copy actions.
- Gate Crestodian on the route-bound default agent's effective model, hide it while model state is absent/loading/failed, and refresh Settings from config-route invalidation without allowing stale responses to restore the helper.

Codex contract checked directly at `openai/codex@0d18d4f7535d93ce7fd0ffa9ca69937321352688`: the CLI accepts API-key login through stdin and persists it ([CLI dispatch](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/0d18d4f7535d93ce7fd0ffa9ca69937321352688/codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs#L1350-L1374)); auth loading falls back to the configured persistent store when environment auth is disabled ([auth manager](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/0d18d4f7535d93ce7fd0ffa9ca69937321352688/codex-rs/login/src/auth/manager.rs#L1215-L1285)); and app-server constructs its auth manager with API-key environment loading disabled ([app-server bootstrap](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/0d18d4f7535d93ce7fd0ffa9ca69937321352688/codex-rs/app-server/src/lib.rs#L477-L507)).

## User Impact

Fresh macOS installs can reuse a logged-in Codex CLI, verify it with a real turn, and keep the working runtime choice across app relaunches. Setup failures remain retryable and now expose useful sanitized details. Crestodian is absent until inference is actually configured.

## Evidence

- Baseline matrix on a restored Parallels macOS 26.5 VM:
  - released CLI + direct OpenAI API key: install, onboarding, and real `openai/gpt-5.5` turn passed;
  - released Mac app reproduced its older local-Gateway startup failure, already fixed on current `main` by #99767;
  - current-main Mac app + direct OpenAI API key completed onboarding and a real app chat turn;
  - Claude Code 2.1.205 with its persistent login completed a real CLI turn and the Mac onboarding live test;
  - current-main Codex detection reproduced the false login failure with no `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the app/Gateway environment.
- Exact fixed head `cf04edbb000f0768168a499233f4675c527625a9`, Developer ID-signed Mac app:
  - initial no-Gateway failure exposed expandable details and copied the exact sanitized socket error;
  - no Crestodian link appeared before inference; after the real model test passed, the link appeared;
  - native Codex CLI auth completed the onboarding live test with `openai/gpt-5.5 via Codex` while the app/Gateway API-key environment remained unset;
  - persisted config contained default `openai/gpt-5.5`, model-scoped `agentRuntime.id = codex`, and enabled Codex plugin state;
  - first app chat returned `vm codex ok 20260709`; after killing and relaunching the app, the same session/model returned `vm relaunch ok`.
- Because `@openclaw/codex@latest` predates this unpublished head, the exact-head VM retest used the repository's release packer plus the gated `npm-pack:` install override. Packed plugin SHA-256: `7f10a2d823efb5d98bb0df1068ee182701034cd84f91d1019de2a388854dd402`. Signed app zip SHA-256: `533266251eba353e7a51dd21e8fc9d4ade77da85ee26697e994161deaad3925a`.
- Blacksmith Testbox exact-head `pnpm check:changed`: passed, including type checks, core/extension lint, package guards, and macOS packaging tests (`tbx_01kx3epgvt59amzcwd9r62k3pe`).
- Focused exact-head Testbox regressions: 33/33 passed across OpenAI routing, setup inference, and Codex runtime installation. Swift-focused app tests: 43/43 passed across five suites.
- Exact-head package build: `node scripts/build-all.mjs` passed. Fresh full-branch autoreview: no accepted/actionable findings; patch rated correct with 0.86 confidence.
